log: DOCK THE ACTUAL SUBSTRATE -- the last untested version of structure-based re-ranking
Three re-rankers failed as PER-PROTEIN priors because 68.5% of the ranking errors are
enzyme-against-enzyme. This makes the score pair-specific: the reaction's own substrate,
into each candidate's pocket. Scores are Z-SCORES against decoy ligands in the SAME pocket,
because raw binding energy is always negative and says only 'this pocket is sticky'.
MEASURES BINDING PLAUSIBILITY, NOT CATALYSIS -- albumin binds most of the metabolome.
89 held-out reactions have a resolvable main substrate AND >=5 cached structures
11 decoy ligands built for pocket normalisation
It beats the random-substrate control (0.600 vs 0.475) but not the shortlist
(0.825). So substrate identity IS being read, but the language model's ordering
already contains more than the docking adds.
